name: Azeroth Companion
title: Character Dominion — Unified Objectives & Armory Handoff
features: Introduced Character Dominion: a responsive character-centered command view unifying manually saved characters, priority item targets, completed objectives and recent farming activity.
Added a next-objective recommendation based on existing manual target priorities and recorded character attempts; item ownership is never inferred from Blizzard data.
Added quick assignment of Item Atlas items to a selected character, manual complete/reopen actions, and direct item inspection while preserving Character Targets formats and limits.

Repaired the My Azeroth to Public Armory handoff: character selectors prefill Armory, appear beside an explicit Save Character to My Planners action, and are removed from the public URL after arrival.
Synchronized same-tab character imports and objective changes between Character Targets, Farming Operations, Item Atlas and the new character dashboard.

Added an opt-in public Blizzard character profile research summary in Character Dominion, visible only after a player initiates a Live Armory lookup and never treated as authenticated account ownership.
Updated the Information & Player Guide with Character Dominion and corrected Player Field Lab reports so they no longer hardcode v4.2 as the active app.
Preserved Battle.net verification, Cloudflare Worker, all existing studios, independent manual data and Discord release automation; added v4.3 integration regression checks.
